Lesson: (1) Staging must use its own Redis instance. (2) app.json must NOT provision redis for CI test runs. (3) Add REDIS_COMMAND_COUNT env var monitoring. CI_DYNO_LEARNED: Heroku CI does NOT support Eco dynos. app.json test formation must use standard-1x minimum. The platform capability detection (dyno-manager.mjs detect) correctly identifies this. Lesson: (1) Always run 'node scripts/dyno-manager.mjs detect' before CI setup. (2) Test formation size must be standard-1x not eco. (3) CI test runs must NOT provision Redis (removed from addons).

QSTASH_CONFIGURED: QStash message queue credentials pushed to Heroku staging config vars. QStash replaces Redis BRPOP polling (monitor-worker, hermes-worker) with push-based message delivery. Eliminates remaining Redis command consumption from worker polling loops. Tokens stored securely in Heroku config vars — never committed to git.
